name: tools
description: Queue careful repository and office maintenance reviews

hooks.name: repository-cleanup
hooks.description: Queue a comprehensive repository cleanup after current work
command: After current work reaches a safe stopping point, queue and delegate a comprehensive repository cleanup. Inspect before deleting or changing anything. Review stale AI-authored comments, README organization, needless bloat, and repository hygiene. Preserve user work and active worktrees. Avoid destructive shortcuts, including broad deletions, resets, or forced cleanup.

hooks.name: storage-cleanup
hooks.description: Safely audit obsolete .omo/storage artifacts and messages
command: After current work reaches a safe stopping point, queue and delegate a careful audit of obsolete .omo/storage artifacts and messages. Inspect before deleting anything, identify ownership and current relevance. Preserve user work and active office state. Avoid destructive shortcuts, including broad deletions, resets, or forced cleanup.
